Candidates · National Assembly · 1977 – 2024

The same people, election after electionوہی چہرے بار بار

Pakistan's National Assembly is a house of long careers. Fifteen politicians have won six or more general elections; thousands of candidacies changed party between runs; and dozens of documented families pass seats between generations. This page follows the people rather than the parties — careers, switches, and dynasties across eleven elections.
